headline: The characters were being drawn inside-out. Three separate geometry generators had inverted triangle winding; the two that build the entire body accounted for 153,344 of 227,850 triangles rendering with a normal pointing away from the camera. Fixed, 0 remaining, with a guard that goes red.

done_and_measured.what: Inverted triangle winding in three generators in game/src/render/actor.js
done_and_measured.instrument: tools/visual/mesh-winding.mjs (new), signed-volume + normal-agreement + boundary-edge, 13 subjects / 715 meshes
done_and_measured.before: 65 of 715 meshes with NEGATIVE signed volume; 153,344 of 227,850 triangles whose authored normal disagrees with their winding (67.3%). actor-body:<family>:skin 13/13 inverted (102,708/109,792), actor-body:<family>:cloth 13/13 inverted (49,088/51,896).
done_and_measured.after: 0 of 715 inverted; 0 of 227,850 disagreeing. Tool exits 0.
generators_fixed: MeshBuilder.tube / .ball / .ellipsoid — side walls wound A,C,B (inward). tube's end CAPS were always correct, which is why the disagreement was 94% and not 100% and why one mesh carried two conventions.

garmentTabGeometry — the whole index list inverted. Invisible to a normal check because computeVertexNormals() derives normals FROM winding; only signed volume caught it (13/13 :legs meshes negative).
torsoShellGeometry — CAPS ONLY inverted, walls always correct. 36 tris per shell, matching the measured 144/720 on tailored-tunic over 4 meshes exactly.
done_and_measured.why_it_matters: With FrontSide (every actor material; no mesh is DoubleSide) WebGL culls by screen-space winding. Inverted winding culls the NEAR surface and draws the FAR one — the owner's see-through report, and not a hole, so the previous round's gap-pixel census counted it as one and hole-filling could never reach it. It also inverted the lighting on 94% of the visible body, which is a direct contributor to the critic's finding #1 ('ellipsoid shoulders on a slab torso') because shading is what makes a form read as a form.
done_and_measured.control: mesh-winding.mjs --self-test reverses a correct sphere and asserts the tool goes red; it does. A separate control geometry (mirror-x with no index reversal) reproduces the classic flip at -1.075e-1. All seven THREE built-ins used by the presentation path measure positive, so the comparison is against the engine's own convention, not against my reasoning.

done_and_measured.what: verdict §7 fix 1 — route the reptilian races to the reptilian body
done_and_measured.before: renderer.js:693 tested (race==='saxhleel'||race==='naga'); 181 argonian records fell through to base.humanoid. npcs_per_art_family = {saxhleel: 79, humanoid: 329}.
done_and_measured.after: npcs_per_art_family = {saxhleel: 260, humanoid: 148} — meets the >=260 acceptance exactly. Median pairwise silhouette IoU 0.9109 -> 0.8954; the argonian-vs-breton IoU 1.0000 pair named in the verdict is gone.
done_and_measured.ruling_on_the_data_defect: BOTH, but not by rewriting 181 records. Saxhleel is the endonym and Argonian the Cyrodilic exonym for one people, so content using both is lore working, not a typo; what was wrong is that the renderer treated a NAME as a BODY PLAN. The map now lives once in game/src/render/lib/race-art.js and covers all 12 in-use strings plus none/mixed/khajiit with stated reasons. races.json is deliberately untouched: its own invariant is sum(attribute_deltas)==12 per race record and four checkers read races.map(r=>r.id), so an alias row there would break a progression invariant to solve a rendering problem. REVERSIBLE — overturned if a later piece needs argonian and saxhleel to differ in reaction or standing; nothing in disposition.js or race-reactions.json distinguishes them today.
done_and_measured.drift_guard: tools/visual/f10-silhouette.mjs held a hand-copy of the predicate annotated 'verbatim'. It now imports the same function renderer.js calls, so the instrument cannot measure the old world. tools/check-race-art.mjs walks the shipped NPC data and exits non-zero on any race string with no declared body plan; --self-test proves it goes red.
